title: Start here — v0.6 placement authority
summary: Authority-constrained job placement across heterogeneous execution nodes. Hard eligibility is evaluated before optimisation; security/legal/access/runtime/software/architecture/liveness/mandatory resource requirements cannot be outweighed by capacity, speed or cost.
invariants: Hard constraints are never soft scores.
Node capability is distinct from transient capacity.
API Client remains egress-session authority after general node placement.
